notablePrerequisites: Good-Fortune Unicorn has at least one +1/+1 counter.
description:
Activate Animation Module by paying {3} and tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Good-Fortune Unicorn.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1}, creating a 1/1 Servo creature token.
Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Servo token.
Animation Module triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Servo token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module ability by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Servo creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
